reviews.title: Title: Disappointing recent experience despite being a loyal customer.
reviews.body: I’ve been a very loyal user of Dr. Sheth’s — I regularly repurchase their moisturiser and sunscreen like essentials. However, my last two sunscreen purchases have been disappointing. This variant is extremely runny, making it hard to apply the correct amount. It leaves a noticeable grey/white cast and requires a lot of blending. I also experienced brief tingling on application, which is concerning for sensitive skin. Despite being fluid, it feels heavy and leaves a slightly greasy layer on the face. And it is even more expensive then the other sunscreens. Overall, not up to the brand’s usual standard and not something I’d repurchase.
